cues: The lead storage battery, in every car and in the inverters that keep Nepali homes lit during load shedding.
A lead plate is the anode, lead dioxide the cathode, both in about thirty eight percent sulphuric acid.
On discharge, both plates turn into lead sulphate, and the sulphuric acid is used up, turning to water.
